mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.1% indicates aggressive monetary easing that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate financing costs decline.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.1% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeds 3.0%, it triggers preemptive Federal Reserve tightening that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in GDP growth (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) for two consecutive months signals collapsing consumer demand, reducing corporate revenue expectations and generating negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both GDPC1 and HOUST decline for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: In high-unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.0%), a concurrent decline in payrolls (PAYEMS) and unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending power and causes negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0% and PAYEMS declines for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) for two consecutive months reflects robust manufacturing output, which correlates with rising corporate profits and generates positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO rises for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: In low-interest-rate regimes (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%), a decline in retail sales (RSAFS) signals weakening consumer spending, reducing corporate revenue growth expectations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS declines in a low-interest-rate regime.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate increase above 4.0% for two consecutive months triggers monetary tightening that raises equity discount rates, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days as risk premiums rise.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0% for two consecutive months, it indicates labor market weakness that reduces consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0% for two consecutive months.
